perducto , āre, 1, v. freq. a. perduco,
I.to lead, conduct to or over a place (Plautin. in the double sense of perductor, q. v.): “quicquid est, errabo potius, quam perductet quispiam,” Plaut. Most. 3, 2, 160 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
